objective: Barbershop Booking System — responsive website, booking, API/database, management dashboard

items.description: Landing and service prices readable at 375px and 1440px; booking supports service, barber, date/time and confirmation with loading/empty/error states.
Integration tests prove duration-aware availability, invalid/past slot rejection and exactly one success for concurrent overlapping requests for the same barber; cancelled slots reusable.
Database persists customers, barbers, services and appointments across restart; dashboard lists/filter appointments and supports Pending, Completed and Cancelled transitions.
Protected dashboard and management endpoints reject unauthorized requests; server validates inputs; secrets absent from client and repository; customer information limited to authorized views.
Strict TypeScript, production build, lint and co-located source tests pass; critical booking and authorization paths covered.
items.command: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build

items.description: QA verifies keyboard navigation, labels/focus, responsive screens, success and error flows; no open critical/high severity defects.
README provides local setup, environment example, migrations/seed, test commands and demo account; timezone, opening hours, cancellation policy and MVP assumptions documented.

approvalNote: Explicit orchestrator approval received in conversation; concurrency and security are critical gates.
